title: apcore sys_modules Namespace Schema
description: JSON Schema for the `sys_modules` configuration namespace registered by PROTOCOL_SPEC §9.15.3 (env prefix APCORE_SYS). §9.15.3 has referenced this file since it was written; this is that file. It is the canonical declaration of every key `register_sys_modules()` reads, so an SDK default table carrying a `sys_modules.*` key absent from here is an SDK-invented default.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, no system.* module is registered and every other key here is inert.
Whether system.health.summary and system.health.module are registered.
Whether system.manifest.module and system.manifest.full are registered.

usage.description: system.usage.* module group and the collector backing it.

enabled.description: Whether system.usage.summary and system.usage.module are registered.

retention_hours.description: How long usage records are retained by the collector.

bucketing_strategy.description: Granularity of the usage distribution buckets.

control.description: system.control.* module group. These modules are approval-gated (annotations.requires_approval = true).

enabled.description: Whether the system.control.* modules are registered.

overrides_path.description: Path to the runtime overrides file. When set and no OverridesStore is supplied explicitly, a file-backed store is constructed from it.

max_entries_per_module.description: Maximum retained error entries per module.

max_total_entries.description: Maximum retained error entries across all modules.

events.description: Event emitter and the platform-notify thresholds derived from it.

enabled.description: Whether an EventEmitter is created and the event-driven system.control.* modules are registered.

subscribers.description: Declarative subscriber definitions instantiated at registration time. Each entry needs a `type` naming a registered subscriber factory (webhook, a2a, file, stdout, filter).

error_rate.description: Error rate at or above which apcore.health.error_threshold_exceeded is emitted.

latency_p99_ms.description: p99 latency in milliseconds at or above which apcore.health.latency_threshold_exceeded is emitted.
